_note: The Hyprland animation API this project is allowed to drive, with the leaf tree, the styles each leaf accepts and the curve shapes hl.curve() builds. Hyprland rejects an unknown leaf, an unregistered curve or a style that is not valid for that leaf with a config error, so a mistake is loud rather than silent -- but a leaf or style that is merely wrong for the effect intended still ships a desktop that animates the wrong way. gen_animations_lua.py refuses to emit a leaf, curve or style that is not recorded here.
source: src/config/shared/animation/AnimationTree.cpp (the leaf tree: every createNode name and its parent, and the built-in curve names the root nodes use), src/config/lua/bindings/LuaBindingsConfigRules.cpp (hl.curve and hl.animation: the bezier and spring shapes, the speed>0 and per-spring-value>0.5 bounds, and that a leaf must exist and a style must be valid for it), src/animation/AnimationManager.cpp (styleValidInConfigVar: which styles each leaf accepts)

diagnostics.unknown_leaf: hl.animation errors: "no such animation leaf" (nodeExists is false).
diagnostics.unknown_curve: hl.animation errors: "no such bezier" or "no such spring" if the name was never registered with hl.curve and is not a built-in.
diagnostics.bad_style: hl.animation errors with styleValidInConfigVar's reason, e.g. "unknown style" or "animation has no styles".
diagnostics.bad_speed: hl.animation errors: "speed must be greater than 0".
diagnostics.bad_spring: hl.curve errors if stiffness, damping or mass is <= 0.5.
diagnostics.consequence: Hyprland refuses the whole config on any of these, so unlike the forgiving engines a mistake is loud -- but this project still gates the render, because a leaf or style that is valid yet wrong for the effect ships a desktop that animates wrongly.

bezier.constraints: exactly 2 points, each a table of 2 numbers, and each of the four coordinates inside [-1, 2]. LuaBindingsConfigRules.cpp parses every coordinate with CLuaConfigFloat(0, -1, 2), which returns PARSE_ERROR_OUT_OF_RANGE rather than clamping, so a coordinate outside that range fails hl.curve and Hyprland rejects the whole config. Overshoot (y above 1) and undershoot (y below 0) inside the range are valid, and are how a spring-like bezier is expressed: the shipped static animations/default.lua already uses {0.1, 1.1} and {0.3, -0.3}.

spring.shape: { type = "spring", stiffness = s, damping = d, mass = m }
spring.constraints: stiffness, damping and mass each strictly greater than 0.5

speed_formula.source: hyprutils src/animation/AnimatedVariable.cpp CBaseAnimatedVariable::getPercent(): percent = clamp((elapsed_ms / 100) / internalSpeed, 0, 1); the animation finishes when percent reaches 1, i.e. after 100*speed milliseconds. hl.animation additionally rejects speed <= 0, and parses speed with CLuaConfigFloat(0, 0, 100), which returns PARSE_ERROR_OUT_OF_RANGE instead of clamping (src/config/lua/types/LuaConfigFloat.cpp:30-48). So a usable speed is in (0, 100] and a usable duration in (0, 10000] ms, and a value outside that is a loud config error rather than a silent clamp.
speed_formula.consequence: 'speed' is a duration in centiseconds despite the name: a larger value is a SLOWER, longer animation. The shipped static default.lua confirms it -- border speed=1 is a 100ms colour snap, borderangle speed=30 a 3000ms gradient sweep, fade speed=10 a 1s fade. gen_animations_lua.py derives every speed as duration_ms/100 from the motion tokens rather than picking a number by hand.

animation_params.leaf: string, required; must be a node in the tree
animation_params.enabled: bool; false (or absent) disables the leaf. hl.animation returns early on enabled=false after setConfigForNode(leaf, false, 1, "default"), so a disabled leaf needs no speed, bezier or spring
animation_params.speed: number in (0, 100]; duration_ms = 100 * speed, so despite the name a larger value is a SLOWER, longer animation (Hyprland's own global default is 8, i.e. 800 ms). Out of range is PARSE_ERROR_OUT_OF_RANGE, not a clamp. For a spring curve the value is inert -- the spring integrates to its own resting time -- but the binding still requires it to be present and greater than 0
animation_params.bezier: string; the name of a registered or built-in bezier curve (mutually required with spring)
animation_params.spring: string; the name of a registered spring curve (mutually required with bezier)
animation_params.style: string, optional; must be valid for the leaf, and a leaf with no styles must omit it

master_switch.note: The master kill-switch: false disables every animation regardless of per-leaf enabled flags. The Performance intensity sets it false, which is how it measurably lowers compositor work (docs/UNVERIFIED.md PERF-01 records that the frame-time saving was not measured on hardware).

style_rules.note: 'slide' and 'popin' also accept a ' NN%' suffix
the empty style (omitting style) is also valid here
